scope: Reference triage, not a capability-completion matrix. Historical images are local artifacts, not reproducible current baselines.

references.word: Word web in Safari; dark theme; seven tabs; desktop/contextual tools unverified

categories.name: Home
categories.nextEvidence: Complete Home/Clipboard/Font/Paragraph acceptance, including native Safari/OS clipboard prompts, pointer painter, mixed-state presentation, other Font controls, IME, lists and required external formats. These scoped workflows do not certify the whole tab.

underline.scope: Direct multirun underline application/removal, one-step undo/redo, read-only controls, DOCX XML and self-reimport; Word/PDF/inherited styles and real Safari unverified.

clipboard.scope: Deterministic Clipboard API adapters and synthetic native events in three engines: rich/text/merge, failure feedback, original targets, Cut/Copy and one-step undo. Real OS permission/gesture, Word, DOCX/PDF and image-only flows unverified.

painter.scope: Inherited appearance, actual Shift+End keyboard selection, one-shot/continuous, undo/redo and lifecycle cancellation in three engines; target carets seeded through the client. Pointer/touch, real Safari/VoiceOver and DOCX/PDF unverified.

inheritedFont.scope: Inherited Bold/Italic/Underline off and Single replacement, range preservation, one-step undo/redo, caret typing, explicit DOCX reset XML and self-reimport in three engines. Other properties, mixed-state presentation, IME, Word/PDF and real Safari workflows unverified.
